name: TinTinLand
rootCause: According to the SlowMist security team, the community TinTinLand's pinned tweet on July 20 contained a phishing link. With the assistance of the SlowMist security team, TinTinLand promptly resolved the account theft issue and conducted an authorization review and security reinforcement of their Twitter account.
